title: Home Mortgage Loans: when escrow is mandatory and the escrow waiver fee
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: when escrow is mandatory and the escrow waiver fee

This quick-reference card gives, for each Home Mortgage Loans program, the original loan-to-value ratio (LTV) above which an escrow account for property taxes and insurance is mandatory, and the one-time fee to waive escrow where a waiver is allowed.

## Parameters by program

| Program | Escrow mandatory when original LTV exceeds (%) | One-time escrow waiver fee (% of loan amount) |
|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Always mandatory | Not applicable |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Always mandatory | Not applicable |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 | 0.25 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 | 0.25 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 80 | 0.25 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 | 0.00 |

"Always mandatory" means escrow is required on every loan of that program, whatever the original LTV. "Not applicable" means the program sets no waiver fee.

## Worked examples (hypothetical amounts)

- **Conventional waiver fee.** For a hypothetical loan amount of 400000.00 in the Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, 0.25 percent of 400000.00 is 1000.00.
- **Jumbo waiver fee.** 0.00 percent of any Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage loan amount is 0.00.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical original LTVs)

| Program | Hypothetical original LTV | Against the mandatory-escrow threshold |
|---|---|---|
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80.00 | Does not exceed 80 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80.01 | Exceeds 80: escrow mandatory |
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 70.00 | Escrow mandatory, as it is always mandatory in this program |
